completion_rule: prepare -> generate real draft.jsonl -> finish structure/count -> DRAFT_CREATED -> next stream; no review, oracle, acceptance, export or training in this stage.
ordering_rule: Explicit user ID wins; otherwise first unfinished stream. Preserve the original 129 objective streams, then new objectives (165 total), then 27 uncovered parent streams. NEXT uses exact stream IDs and this complete queue. STOP halts actions. Resume existing request/state/handle; do not rerun it.
budget_rule: Parent/profile pools total 132000 TRAIN pairs; assigned complete groups 131987, unallocated reserve 13. Objective allocations replace covered parent streams; pilot TRAIN is included. DEV/EXAM are independent held-out data. All values are planned quotas, not observed generation or learning.
